title: Cadet/Graduate Engineer
rationale:
Graduate civil design role in a council team: roads, drainage, documentation, site inspections.
Diploma coursework matches the design side; degree covered surveying; site experience from the Philippines.
NSW licence transfer, Total Station and MS Project are gaps; Sydney relocation.
caution: Rough fit, not an interview forecast. Employer acceptance of a time-limited 485 visa and relocation are the main unknowns.
gaps: Confirm Graduate stream eligibility with a completed Advanced Diploma plus Bachelor
apply_instructions: All applications must be submitted through the Council's website. waverley.nsw.gov.au/council/jobs
